name: Bauernfangen
summary: Austrian trick-taking game where players first avoid then hunt four Jacks with different cash values.
rules_text: Play with 20 cards: Ace, King, Ober, Unter/Bower (Jack), Ten in each of four suits. No trumps. For 4-5 players. The match has 8 deals: 4 in the first leg and 4 in the second leg. Dealer deals all cards evenly clockwise. Eldest hand leads, must follow suit if possible but need not win; void players may discard anything. Highest card of led suit wins trick and leads next. In first leg, any Unter captured forces its holder to pay its value into a central pot: Hearts 0.40, Bells/Diamonds 0.30, Leaves/Spades 0.20, Acorns/Clubs 0.10. In second leg, capturing an Unter wins its value from the pot. After 8 deals, total money won minus paid defines the ranking.
rating_reason: Trick-taking for 4-5 players, specific regional whist type.
